W sub-tile rows r = 0–7 (same colors across all 3 panels)Bank conflict: >1 distinct 4 B word hits the same bank in one read → 1 served per bank per wavefront in serial order (1 wavefront = one parallel SMEM pass serving ≤1 4 B word per bank, up to 128 B)Conflict-free: 1 request per bank in one read → all bytes delivered in 1 wavefrontActive hardware unit in this step8 chunks of logical column c read in this step (row-colored with ink outline; other chunks dimmed)Cumulative bytes delivered into consumer registers"Write" pre-step (causal order only, not to cycle scale)

Use the mode cards below the figure frame and the step buttons to compare the middle bank-request bars with the bottom timeline. XOR swizzling spreads each column read across all banks without conflict, cutting read passes to one-eighth with no extra shared memory.

Details
  • Banks and wavefront rule: SMEM is split into 32 parallel 4 B banks (bank=⌊offset/4⌋ mod 32\mathrm{bank} = \lfloor \mathrm{offset}/4 \rfloor \bmod 32bank=⌊offset/4⌋mod32); one parallel SMEM pass serving at most one 4 B word per bank is 1 wavefront (up to 32×4=128 B32 \times 4 = 128\ \mathrm{B}32×4=128 B per wavefront); 16 B shared-memory loads split a warp into 4 groups of 8 threads, evaluating conflicts per 8-thread group (8×16 B=128 B8 \times 16\ \mathrm{B} = 128\ \mathrm{B}8×16 B=128 B per group read).
  • Unswizzled layout: offset(r,c)=128r+16c\mathrm{offset}(r,c) = 128r + 16coffset(r,c)=128r+16c piles all 8 chunks of logical column ccc across 8 rows onto slot p=cp = cp=c (banks 4c…4c+34c\dots 4c+34c…4c+3) in an 8-way conflict, taking 64 wavefronts across 8 columns (16 B/wavefront on average).
  • 128 B XOR swizzle: offset(r,c)=128r+16(c⊕r)\mathrm{offset}(r,c) = 128r + 16(c \oplus r)offset(r,c)=128r+16(c⊕r) (on a 1,024 B-aligned base) sets p=c⊕rp = c \oplus rp=c⊕r to spread every column ccc across all 8 slots so all 32 banks get 1 request each, taking 1/8 as many wavefronts as unswizzled (8 vs. 64, full 128 B/wavefront peak) at 0 B extra SMEM.
  • Shared-HBM stack mapping: the sub-tile sits in the 6-stack shared HBM with an undisclosed, unspecified address-to-stack map.
  • Schematic vs. byte-scale parts: hardware box sizes and the SMEM-to-register return path are schematic while slots p=0…7p = 0\dots 7p=0…7 and the 32 banks are to byte scale; Mode 1's 4 B word grouping and row order per wavefront are schematic (undisclosed).
  • Measured vs. unmeasured cycles: single-warp 4 B loads add about 2 cycles per extra wavefront (reason not measured), and 8-way intra-group 16 B load cycles were not measured.
